name: qubit
description: Qubit Dialogues monorepo: design tokens, book reader, content, QA harness.

scripts.build: npm run build:book && npm run build:site && npm run build:illustrated && npm run build:hindi && npm run build:unpolarized
scripts.qa:site: npm run build:site && npm run parity -w @qubit/site && npm run test -w @qubit/site
scripts.qa:illustrated: npm run posters -w @qubit/illustrated && npm run determinism -w @qubit/illustrated && npm run static -w @qubit/illustrated && npm run perf -w @qubit/illustrated
scripts.qa: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm run parity && npm run census:check && npm run check:hindi && npm run check:unpolarized && npm run test && npm run qa:site && npm run qa:illustrated
